mechanism: Lock one original clearly adult vlog subject with stable face, handheld distance and route direction. Build at least four event chapters, and require one acquired, used or carried object from each chapter to motivate the next: a food or token proves arrival, a game action earns a prize, the prize or gaze leads to a larger environmental spectacle, and the subject carries a visible residue into farewell. Escalate scale from hand to stall to crowd or sky, then return to the same selfie relation. The reusable mechanism is object-motivated chapter relay, action-result proof, scale ascent and same-subject farewell—not the source woman, clothing, festival, food, ring toss, plush, fireworks, locations, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Lock one clearly adult original vlog subject, stable handheld distance and one route direction.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing narrator or route makes unrelated tourism clips.

invariants.rule: Use at least four chapters and let one acquired, used or carried object motivate each transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Location-only cuts become a postcard montage.

invariants.rule: Show one action-result pair for any game, purchase or exchange.
invariants.purpose: Proves how the object was obtained.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unexplained prize breaks the route.

invariants.rule: Escalate visual scale from hand to stall or activity to a larger environmental event.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting at sky scale leaves no progression.

invariants.rule: Return to the same selfie relation with at least one accumulated object or residue for farewell.
invariants.ablation_failure: An anonymous spectacle ending loses the narrator.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
